integrations_researched.name: Agentation
integrations_researched.description: Visual feedback tool for AI coding agents - allows developers to click UI elements, add annotations, and generate structured output with CSS selectors that AI agents can understand

key_functions: <Agentation /> - renders annotation toolbar in bottom-right corner
endpoint - server URL for MCP sync (e.g., 'http://localhost:4747')

configuration.notes: Zero runtime dependencies beyond React peer dependency

infrastructure.notes: MCP server runs locally via agentation-mcp package

gotchas: React 19 compatibility unverified - package requires React 18+ but may work with React 19
Desktop browsers only - mobile not supported
Client-side only component with DOM access requirement
License: PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 - may have usage restrictions, needs legal review
Local-first architecture - annotations sync when server becomes available
No external data transmission by default - all processing is browser-based until manual sharing

integrations_researched.name: agentation-mcp
integrations_researched.description: MCP server for Agentation that enables real-time bidirectional communication between browser annotations and AI coding agents

key_functions: agentation_get_session - retrieve session with all annotations
agentation_get_pending - view unacknowledged annotations for a session
agentation_get_all_pending - see unaddressed feedback across all pages
agentation_reply - add thread responses to annotations
agentation_watch_annotations - block until new annotations appear

cli_commands: npx agentation-mcp init - interactive setup wizard
npx agentation-mcp server - launches HTTP and MCP servers
npx agentation-mcp doctor - validates Node.js and connectivity
npx add-mcp 'npx -y agentation-mcp server' - auto-configure for Claude Code

gotchas: Architecture: toolbar → HTTP server → MCP server → agent
Server must be running for real-time sync between browser and agent
Multiple concurrent sessions supported with session IDs

integrations_researched.name: Model Context Protocol (MCP)
integrations_researched.description: Open protocol by Anthropic for seamless integration between LLM applications and external data sources/tools. Already integrated in project via @modelcontextprotocol/sdk

env_vars: ELECTRON_MCP_ENABLED - set to 'true' to enable MCP server
configuration.notes: MCP infrastructure already exists in project at apps/frontend/src/main/mcp-manager.ts

gotchas: Project already has MCP infrastructure - can extend existing setup
ElectronMCPServer class in mcp-server.ts provides existing implementation pattern
MCP donated to Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation in Dec 2025
Wide adoption: OpenAI, Google DeepMind, Microsoft all support MCP

react_version.notes: React 18+ peer dependency should support React 19, but needs testing

electron_version.notes: Electron uses Chromium for rendering, should work like desktop browser

mcp_infrastructure.notes: Can extend existing MCP infrastructure instead of adding parallel system

unverified_claims.reason: Documentation only specifies React 18+ requirement, no explicit React 19 testing documented
unverified_claims.mitigation: Test with --legacy-peer-deps or verify in development before full integration

unverified_claims.reason: Documentation says 'desktop browser only' but doesn't mention Electron specifically
unverified_claims.mitigation: Electron uses Chromium renderer, should work like standard browser

unverified_claims.claim: PolyForm Shield 1.0.0 license is compatible with AGPL-3.0
unverified_claims.reason: Auto-Claude frontend uses AGPL-3.0, need to verify license compatibility for dependencies
unverified_claims.mitigation: Review PolyForm Shield license terms before production use

recommendations: Install agentation as devDependency since it's only needed during development
Extend existing MCP infrastructure in mcp-server.ts rather than running separate agentation-mcp server
Add Agentation component conditionally only in development mode
Create dedicated 'UX Feedback' workflow in Auto-Claude that: 1) Captures annotations 2) Converts to tasks 3) Routes to appropriate spec creation
Consider creating MCP bridge tool that connects agentation annotations to spec_runner.py for automatic task creation
Test React 19 compatibility before full integration - may need --legacy-peer-deps flag
Review PolyForm Shield license for any usage restrictions

implementation_approach.summary: Integrate Agentation visual feedback tool into the Electron prototype to enable click-to-annotate UX feedback that automatically creates development tasks
workflow: 1. User activates annotation mode in running prototype
2. User clicks problematic UI elements and adds notes
3. Agentation captures CSS selectors, position, context as structured markdown
4. System converts annotations to task descriptions via MCP tools
5. Tasks automatically created in spec system via spec_runner.py integration
6. Developers implement fixes with precise code location information
key_benefits: Eliminates vague UI issue descriptions ('the blue button is wrong')
Provides exact CSS selectors for precise code location
Creates machine-readable feedback AI agents can act on immediately
Closes feedback loop between prototype testing and task creation
